table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	GodownGroup=GodownGroup.Name,
	GroupName=CASE :as_grouptype WHEN 'M' THEN Manufacturer.name WHEN 'C' THEN itemcategory.name WHEN 'P' THEN itemPacking.name ELSE itemclass.name END,
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	Item.purprice,   
	Item.PackUnits,   
	AreaVolume = Item.AreaVolume,
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),   
	Manufacturer.name,
	classname=itemclass.name,
	Category=itemcategory.name,
	Packing=itempacking.name,
	PackingDesc=item.PackingDesc, 
	UnitPrice = Round(CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Item.saleprice /(case Item.PackUnits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end) WHEN 2 THEN Item.purprice / (case Item.PackUnits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end) ELSE Item.avgprice END, 2)
FROM 
	GodownDetail,
	Godown,
	GodownGroup,
	Manufacturer,   
	Item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (item.packcode = ItemPacking.packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON (Item.iccode = itemclass.iccode),
	ItemCategory
WHERE 
	GodownGroup.GodownGroupCode = :ai_godowngroupcode AND
	GodownGroup.GodownGroupCode = Godown.GodownGroupCode AND
	Godown.GCode = GodownDetail.GCode AND
	Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode and  
	CASE :as_grouptype 
		WHEN 'M' THEN Item.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN Item.ICatCode 
		WHEN 'P' THEN item.PackCode 
		ELSE Item.ICCode END IN (:ai_groupcode) and
	Manufacturer.manfcode = Item.ManfCode and
	Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode and
	Item.active=1
GROUP BY 
	GodownGroup.Name,
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active,
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.PackUnits, 
	Manufacturer.name,
	itemcategory.name,
	Itemclass.name,
	itempacking.name,
	Item.PackingDesc,
	Item.SalePrice,
	Item.PurPrice,
	Item.AvgPrice,
	Item.AreaVolume
table.sort: godowngroup A, groupname A, item_name A
